request.deadline: Three-month staged launch liquidity deployment after enactment, with monthly reporting; other final delivery deadline not stated in document
deliverables: Shared BTC reserve architecture with transparent safety mechanisms
Composable FIRE and ICE Cardano-native assets
Open-source SDKs and adapters for wallets, DEXs, and DeFi protocols
Always-on public dashboards for reserve ratio, supply, liquidity health, fee flows, and deployment status
Monthly governance reports and BTCfi reporting standards
Independent security review, audit, and economic modeling
Staged launch liquidity deployed over three months
request.recipient: Sundial Protocol and Charms, with Intersect proposed as interim fund administrator subject to confirmation and final agreement.
request.what: Fund Alchemy, a Cardano-native Bitcoin treasury protocol and BTCfi infrastructure layer by Sundial Protocol and Charms.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 10,000,000 ada, using an approximate USD 0.20 per ada reference rate for a planning budget of about USD 2.0 million split into two approximately USD 1.0 million pools.
Pool 1 is intended for protocol infrastructure and staged launch liquidity, kept separate from operating expenses and deployed in three tranches over three months.
Pool 2 is intended for delivery, audit, integrations, dashboards, legal and compliance work, reporting, go-to-market, administration, and related execution costs with itemized planning allocations.

Alchemy would use a shared BTC reserve backing FIRE and ICE, with reserve-ratio formulas, an initial 5.0x target reserve ratio, and safety zones that constrain minting, redemption, and risky activity as reserve ratios fall.
FIRE is described as the volatility-absorbing residual BTC upside and first-loss asset, while ICE is described as a lower-volatility USD-denominated BTC-backed asset.

The proposal says profits, yield, and returns from treasury-supported launch liquidity will be returned to the Cardano Treasury quarterly, while principal may be returned after a 30-day time-weighted average TVL of at least USD 60 million and separate governance approval.
The proposal states that Cardano lacks a serious production BTCfi infrastructure layer and risks Bitcoin-backed structured exposure consolidating on Ethereum, BNB, Solana, and off-chain markets.

The document cites Strategy Q1 2026 results, Strategy Bitcoin purchase figures, Strive activity, and on-chain products such as Apyx, Saturn, and Pendle as evidence of demand for Bitcoin-backed structured exposure.

The proposal identifies BTC volatility, oracle, bridge, Charms protocol-layer, novel asset, delivery, and adoption risks and proposes mitigation through overcollateralization, audits, economic modeling, dashboards, legal work, staged deployment, reporting, pause rules, and administrator oversight.

The proposal asserts it is designed to comply with the Cardano Constitution and prevailing Net Change Limit and lists metadata, administration, custody, reporting, and return conditions as supporting controls.

summary: The document requests 10,000,000 ada for a Cardano BTCfi infrastructure project with separated liquidity and delivery pools, staged deployment, FIRE/ICE reserve mechanics, dashboards, reporting, audits, administrator oversight, and treasury return mechanisms, while making market-demand and constitutional-compliance claims that partly require external verification.
